scripts.dev: echo Run dev:server and dev:web in separate terminals
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.build:prod: npm run build --prefix web && node scripts/copy-web-dist.mjs && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.electron:prepare: node scripts/swap-db-provider.js sqlite && npm run build --prefix web && node scripts/copy-web-dist.mjs && cd server && npm run generate && npm run build
scripts.electron:restore: node scripts/swap-db-provider.js postgresql && cd server && npm run generate
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:prepare && electron . && npm run electron:restore
scripts.electron:build: npm run electron:prepare && electron-builder --win && npm run electron:restore
scripts.electron:build:portable: npm run electron:prepare && electron-builder --win portable && npm run electron:restore
